posts.title: How to add a blog post
posts.description: The template for a post: where the file goes, what its frontmatter needs, and what the text can use.
posts.author: Jashan Singh

faq.question: How does a post get its FAQ rich result?
faq.answer: Under a heading that starts with "FAQ", write each question in bold, ending in "?", with the answer on the next line of the same paragraph. The page sends them as FAQPage structured data, word for word.
